newsitem.title: USA: Ryder sees Q2, Q4 as strongest quarters.
newsitem.headline: Ryder sees Q2, Q4 as strongest quarters.

text.p: Ryder System Inc on Monday said that it expects to see continued positive results for the remainder of the year, noting that its second and fourth quarters will likely be their strongest.

"Our new operating model, which contains three high-quality, profitable businesses in growing markets, is less cyclical and less capital intensive," M. Anthony Burns, Ryder chairman, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
"With the new composition of our business, the second and fourth quarters will typically be Ryder's strongest," he said.

Earlier, the company said its second quarter earnings increased to $0.64 per share compared with $0.39 per share in the second quarter of 1996. Results for the second quarter of 1996 included pretax earnings of $12.4 million from the company's former consumer truck rental operations and a pretax restructuring charge of $19.6 million ($12.4 million after tax) associated with cost reduction programs.
